lines.text: Marry, I will; and this is wisely done.
lines.plainText: Marry I will and this is wisely done

lines.text: Ancient damnation! O most wicked fiend!
lines.plainText: Ancient damnation O most wicked fiend

lines.text: Is it more sin to wish me thus forsworn,
lines.plainText: Is it more sin to wish me thus forsworn

lines.text: Or to dispraise my lord with that same tongue
lines.plainText: Or to dispraise my lord with that same tongue

lines.text: Which she hath prais'd him with above compare
lines.plainText: Which she hath prais'd him with above compare

lines.text: So many thousand times? Go, counsellor.
lines.plainText: So many thousand times Go counsellor

lines.text: Thou and my bosom henceforth shall be twain.
lines.plainText: Thou and my bosom henceforth shall be twain

lines.text: I'll to the Friar to know his remedy.
lines.plainText: I'll to the Friar to know his remedy

lines.text: If all else fail, myself have power to die.
lines.plainText: If all else fail myself have power to die
